subject: Update classify.sh: split ScheduleWakeup (every message) from ready-task nudge (first message only)
description:
Two independent changes to classify.sh:

1. SCHEDULEWAKEUP — inject every message:
   - Always append: "[Orchestrator heartbeat] Call ScheduleWakeup(delaySeconds=7200, reason='idle heartbeat', prompt='<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>') to keep session alive. On wakeup: if no ready tasks AND no active loop, do NOT reschedule — stop the loop."
   - Exception: on wakeup turns where daemon confirms no ready tasks + no active loop → inject "nothing to watch, stop the loop" instead

2. READY TASK NUDGE — first message only, then stop:
   - Keep the existing flag file system
   - But: after first message shows the nudge, write a "busy" marker (/tmp/orch-busy-$SID) so it does NOT inject on subsequent messages
   - Delete busy marker when: wakeup fires (re-surface on wakeup turns), or task-notification context detected
   - Remove the current "inject every message when flag exists" behavior — replace with "inject only if no busy marker"

Read classify.sh carefully. Surgical changes only.
